scope: Existing frozen raw traces only; no trial, parameter, threshold or core change; exact differences report magnitude, no numerical acceptance cutoff

field_definitions.wheel_dynamics.force_fields: fx/fy, force_kappa/alpha, force_patch_kappa/alpha and deformation/energy are final tire substep values of the force phase labelled force_contact_tick; force normal_load is previous completed contact used for this step
field_definitions.wheel_dynamics.sample_fields: omega and longitudinal/lateral speed, kappa/alpha, sample_support/sample_tick are completed Bullet observation; omega is also end-of-tire rotation state; do not infer force-stage slip from completed velocities
field_definitions.contacts: wheel_contacts are completed current raycast points/normal/loads at state.contact_tick, usable for next tick force; in_contact is not chassis-plane manifold
field_definitions.brakes: requested includes ESC/TCS arbitration; commanded includes ABS; pressure follows finite actuator response; feedback_tick labels previous complete wheel input; commanded-requested isolates ABS adjustment
field_definitions.ESC: observed_yaw_rate is pre-force angular velocity projected on chassis body-up; brake_requests are arbitration output; active/feedback_tick retained
field_definitions.completed_yaw: completed_yaw_rate_radps is post-Bullet world angular.z, not body-up projection; dynamics.yaw_rate is global z after tire impulse and before Bullet
field_definitions.units: steering/heading/pitch/roll degrees; alpha/patch_alpha rad; omega/yaw rad/s; loads/forces N; pressure/request dimensionless; deformation m; energy J
